title: In-Place Home Resale Pre-Sale Inspection Program Sheet
content:
**Community operations — pre-sale inspection program for In-Place Home Resale files.** Every resale file, on every package, goes through the community's pre-sale inspection against the community standards. The package figures for the inspection program are these.

| Package | Initial inspection fee (USD) | Re-inspection fee (USD, each) | Re-inspections included at no fee | Initial inspection performed within (business days of opening) | Initial inspection fee credited back at a brokered closing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | 125.00 | 75.00 | 0 | 5 | No |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 125.00 | 75.00 | 0 | 5 | No |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 125.00 | 75.00 | 0 | 5 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 125.00 | 75.00 | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 0.00 | 75.00 | 2 | 3 | No |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 0.00 | 75.00 | 2 | 3 | No |

| Package | Repairs period after an inspection requiring repairs (calendar days) | Passed inspection supports a buyer approval and closing for (calendar days) | Hearthstone service crew may be engaged for repairs | Markup on contractor cost (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | 30 | 180 | No | not applicable |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 30 | 180 | No | not applicable |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 30 | 180 | No | not applicable |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 30 | 180 | Yes | 15.0 |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 30 | 180 | Yes | 10.0 |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 30 | 180 | Yes | 10.0 |

## Community standards checked (every package)

The inspection checks the home and lot against ten standards items:

1. skirting intact and vented;
2. steps and handrails to code;
3. roof free of leaks and damage;
4. tie-downs and anchors present;
5. smoke and carbon monoxide alarms working;
6. address numbers visible;
7. exterior siding and paint;
8. gutters and downspouts;
9. carport and shed condition;
10. lot clear of debris.

An inspection that finds every item in order is recorded as passed; one that finds items failing is recorded as requiring repairs, with the number of items failed.

**Reading the sheet.** A Full-Service Resale Brokerage file has its first re-inspection included at no fee and its initial inspection within 3 business days of opening; a Resale Approval Service file has no included re-inspection and its initial inspection within 5 business days. A repair coordinated by the service crew on a Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus file costing the contractor 400.00 is billed with a 10.0 percent markup (hypothetical cost).
